The Chinese characters for Alice

As a transliteration, Alice is usually written 艾丽斯 (Ài lì sī). Each character is listed below with its own dictionary meaning — the name is chosen by sound, not by meaning, and Moying does not translate names. Please have a person review the characters before any permanent use such as a tattoo.

艾
Ài
mugwort, artemisia
丽
lì
beautiful
斯
sī
this (transliteration)

Origin and meaning

With Germanic origins, Alice is usually read as “noble”.

About the name Alice

Lewis Carroll's Alice's Adventures in Wonderland made the name a literary icon.

As a gift or a tattoo

Because it means “noble”, an Alice calligraphy print makes a thoughtful gift for someone who loves the name or its meaning.
